name: http-range-witness
user: HTTP storage maintainer inspecting captured Range requests.
pain: Explain suffix, open-ended and overlapping ranges and transfer amplification for a known representation size.
smallest_capability: Bounded byte-range planner with per-member reasons, original request order and separate coalesced coverage.
acceptance: Correct inclusive endpoints, clamping and nonzero suffixes.
Reject malformed or reversed ranges distinctly from unsatisfiable members.
Count repeated transfer bytes separately from unique covered bytes.
demand: Inferred; range-parser's API and merge-order report establish an existing workflow, not missing competitor behavior.
discovery: HTTP range debugging and download fixture examples.
distinctness: No owned tool plans byte-range coverage; cache-header-contract concerns caching policy.
limits: Nonempty representations only; no HTTP server, If-Range, encoding negotiation or multipart responses.
publication: Website publication in progress; remote CI not yet verified
